{{Quote|Not even medical droids can work miracles&hellip; The Human [''sic''] brain cannot be replaced bionically&hellip; and his mind is damaged beyond simple repair!|2-1B medical droid, regarding the brain-damaged Velmoc patient Jedidiah|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref>}}
When the [[Velmoc]] named [[Jedidiah]] was discovered by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''2-1B medical droid''' examined the Velmoc to assess his incoherent mental state. The [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] determined that Jedidiah's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was too severely damaged to be replaced or repaired.
